name: PreTranscode
description:
Kutuphanedeki dosyalari arka planda hedef codec'e once kodlayarak Direct Play oranini artirir.

Orijinal dosyalara dokunmaz, her dosyanin yanina optimize edilmis bir kopya uretir. Jellyfin Dashboard uzerinden kutuphane secimi ve tek tikla kodlama saglar.
overview: Arka planda once kodlama yaparak Direct Play oranini artirir

versions.changelog: Fix VAAPI h264 encoding - removed incorrect software fallback, h264_vaapi works with 10-bit format conversion
Encode cancel button, AMF software fallback (Linux LXC), manifest max 5 versions, HDR tonemap improvements
Add AMD AMF encoder support (h264_amf, hevc_amf) - fast HW encoding for Radeon GPUs
Fix ffprobe path on Linux, VAAPI software fallback for unsupported codecs, HDR tonemap for software encoding
Fix CUDA/NVENC encoding: add hwdownload+format=nv12 filter chain
